log.text: Hi! Is the Telugu work still on track for the pilot schools? Just checking before my call tomorrow.

:robot_face: Hi Lakshmi, I'm *Manish's AI Peer*, an AI assistant that covers for Manish. Manish is offline right now (it's 9:09 PM in India), so here is what Manish's work records say:

Hi Lakshmi! The Telugu work is *moving steadily, but it's still in the early build steps*, per the Telugu tracker (last updated 5 Nov, 01:49 UTC):
• *Done:* the plan (4 Nov), a guard that stops Telugu being published by mistake, and a check that keeps the two code repos in step. Manish also approved the database step to merge.
• *Next:* the language list and the "Help language" setting, then serving content per language. After that come the apps and the first Telugu chapters.
• *Students see nothing new yet.* Telugu stays hidden until the launch step.

*No pilot date is recorded.* An early estimate from 4 Nov, made before the plan was written, said about 2 to 3 weeks to a pilot on web and Android. That's not a commitment. Manish will confirm the timing before your call.

_Sources: <https://github.com/manishjain-py/learnlikemagic/blob/main/docs/feature-development/telugu/STATE.md|Telugu learning language tracker (STATE.md)> (5 Nov 2026) · <https://github.com/manishjain-py/learnlikemagic/pull/708|PR #708: WP2a, the help-language column and the language-access table> (5 Nov 2026) · <https://github.com/manishjain-py/learnlikemagic/pull/705|PR #705: PRD, design and plan for Telugu> (4 Nov 2026). Certainty: medium, as of 5 Nov 2026. I can't make commitments on Manish's behalf; this thread will be waiting when Manish is back._
